findings: Criteria lack details on data schema for persistence.
No explicit mechanism to detect and prevent duplicate tasks.
Recovery strategy does not address partial failures or state rollback.
review.summary: Engineering proposes three acceptance criteria for task swapping focusing on persistence, duplicate prevention, and recovery after interruption.
